ruleDefinitions.name: New Virtual Smart Card Created Via TpmVscMgr.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "Tpmvscmgr.exe" to create a new virtual smart card.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\tpmvscmgr\\\.exe$") AND process_original_file_name = "TpmVscMgr\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*"))
